text:
nina: FYI spotted a gap on the GCP Marketplace reseller export for April. Several reseller invoices show usage = 0 for active subscriptions.
omar: Which reseller? Any big ones?
nina: Reseller: EdgeScale. Affected invoice INV-GCP-8092, reseller balance shows $0 partner_share but GCP feed has usage.
felix: Could be the new sku normalization we shipped last week. The ingest may have dropped the legacy sku variant.
claire: Partners have a ticket complaining about missing payout lines. Ticket PART-1225.
finance-bot: Auto-check: marketplace-export-2026-04-30.csv contained 11 rows with zeroed partner_share where amount>0. See /alerts/marketplace/zero-partner-share-2026-04-30.log
omar: Can you paste one problematic row?
nina: Pasting minimal row we extracted: subscription_id,sku,period,units,amount,partner_share
SUB-7788,gcp-compute-reseller-std-v1,2026-04,12,1200,0
felix: That sku matches the old naming. Our sku alias table expected -std instead of -std-v1 after refactor. The alias migration didn't include reseller suffixes.
claire: How big is the impact?
nina: Quick scan: 6 resellers, total partner_shortfall ~$15,600 for April. EdgeScale is ~$6,200.
felix: I'll add the missing aliases and re-run ingest replay. Need to ensure we don't double-count previously fixed rows.
omar: Finance, will these require retro top-ups?
finance-bot: Policy check: adjustments < $25k can be auto-approved by Head of Finance. Please route CSV for sign-off.
claire: I'll prepare the adjustments CSV and ping Emma.
felix: PR opened to marketplace-ingest alias table: https://git.redwood.internal/p/ingest/pull/541. Includes replay script to regen partner_share.
ina: Partners team, please hold off external comms until we confirm numbers.
finance-bot: Ingest replay job started: ingest-replay-2314021205 (job id c3d2). Logs: /logs/ingest-replay/c3d2
felix: Replay finished, updated 11 rows. Updated partner_share values in /internal/finance/adj/gcp-marketplace-2026-04.csv
claire: Sent CSV to Emma for approval.
finance-bot: Approval received from emma. Adjustment batch scheduled: payout-topup-2314021289.
omar: Can we add a CI test to catch missing reseller alias scenarios?
felix: Yes, will add alias coverage and a regression test for reseller sku suffixes. PR will include tests.
claire: Draft partner comms prepared, will share after Emma sign-off.
finance-bot: Adjustment batch completed. Partners to see credits in next payout.
nina: Filing FIN ticket for postmortem and runbook updates. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
